title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.


Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You’ll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.


Key Qualifications

  • Node.js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.


Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

description:

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing technology company building scalable, data-intensive systems that power both product experiences and AI-driven capabilities. Their platform relies heavily on clean, structured, and reliable data to enable advanced features, automation, and intelligent decision-making.

They are investing in modern data infrastructure to support both core product functionality and emerging AI use cases , ensuring that data is accessible, accurate, and optimized for scale.


Role Overview

We are looking for a full-time (40 hours/week) Senior Data & AI Infrastructure Engineer to design and build the data backbone of our platform.

You will work in the EST time zone , collaborating with engineering teams to support scalable data systems and enable AI-driven functionality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines across multiple sources
  • Design data processing, transformation, and storage systems
  • Create and maintain a canonical data layer
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability
  • Structure datasets for both product and AI use cases
  • Support vector databases and AI data workflows


Requirements

  • Strong experience in data engineering and pipeline development
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow, Dagster, dbt (or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets
  • Ability to build scalable and reliable data systems


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, PgVector)
  • Familiarity with embeddings, retrieval systems, or AI data layers
  • Exposure to modern AI data tools (e.g., MindsDB)


What This Role Focuses On

  • Data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline reliability
  • Building structured, trusted datasets
  • Supporting AI and product systems with high-quality data


Key Traits

  • Strong attention to detail and data quality
  • Systems thinker with scalability mindset
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, complex data

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.


Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You’ll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.


Key Qualifications

  • Node.js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.


Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

About the Role

We are a growing Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) seeking a highly skilled offshore CFP® with strong technical aptitude and process‑automation experience. The ideal candidate will support our advisory team by improving internal workflows and leveraging technology to automate routine tasks within our wealth‑management operations.


This role is ideal for someone who can blend financial-planning expertise with systems thinking, helping us scale efficiently while maintaining a high‑touch client experience.

Process Automation & Systems Optimization

Required

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred

About you:

Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

Benefits & Compensation

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

﻿

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista (RQE) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

description:

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click

title: Founding Engineer (Path to CTO)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Founding Engineer (Path to CTO) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A VAGA


A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa engenheira, builder, intensa e extremamente dona pra ser nossa CTO fundadora.


A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Founding Engineer: codando todos os dias, polindo os 5 produtos até estado lançável, construindo infra compartilhada e operando produto em produção. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, você assume o papel pleno de CTO: contratação, arquitetura, mentoria, direção técnica, e cada vez menos código diário.


Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding Operator, que vamos trazer em paralelo.


SNAPSHOT


• Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges)

• Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO)

• Equity: 15% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão)

• Bônus por milestone de produto: definidos caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários)

• Path to CTO consolidado: Cargo se consolida com 3+ engenheiros sob você e infra em produção com SLA

• Perfil: full-stack sênior ou staff, AI-native, customer-obsessed, confortável codando legal-tech, dev-tools, cloud, ERP e agentes no mesmo mês


O QUE FAZEMOS


A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF.


Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente):

• Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house

• Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs

• Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows

• ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional)

• Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt


NOSSA MISSÃO


Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois.


COMO É O DIA A DIA


Você não vai herdar uma engenharia rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem head of eng, QA dedicado, DevOps. Tem o Pablo (founder, também codador), o Founding Operator (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos com graus diferentes de maturidade.


A pessoa certa abre issue do produto jurídico às 9h, faz code review do dev pleno às 11h, refatora o RAG do produto de analytics à tarde, sobe deploy do produto de cloud à noite, e no dia seguinte abre PR de uma abstração compartilhada que vai servir o próximo micro-app.


NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ:


• Espera receber arquitetura desenhada e sprint planejado. Aqui você É o arquiteto e o planner

• Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, gatilhos e milestones

• Não codifica em produção há mais de 6 meses. A vaga é hands-on do dia 1

• Tem ego de cargo. Você vai escrever código, fazer deploy, debugar produção, code review, JD, tudo, sozinho, no começo

• Não usa IA pra programar (Cursor, Claude, MCP). Aqui IA escreve a maior parte do boilerplate

• Tem medo de mexer em múltiplas linguagens/stacks ao mesmo tempo (TS, Python, infra, AI, frontend)

• Precisa de processo todo desenhado e backlog todo grooming antes de começar

• Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos ship rate, uptime e qualidade semanalmente desde o dia 1


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Construir e shippar (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses):

• Polir os 5 produtos do portfólio até estado lançável (UX, performance, billing, onboarding, observabilidade)

• Codar diariamente em produção. Backend, frontend, infra, AI, integrações: você cobre tudo

• Estabelecer infra compartilhada (billing, auth, observability, analytics) entre os 5 produtos

• Subir o que quebrar, otimizar o que estiver lento, refatorar o que estiver podre


Operar e escalar (escopo cresce a partir do mês 3):

• Uptime, SLAs, segurança, custo de infra, CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call

• Migrar/desmontar o que sobrou de Bubble pra stack code-first quando fizer sentido

• Construir abstrações reutilizáveis pro próximo micro-app entrar com fricção mínima


Construir time e arquitetura (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6):

• Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava

• Formar e mentorar o dev pleno e os juniors que já estão no radar

• Definir padrões de código, arquitetura, testing, code review, documentação

• Trabalhar com o Pablo na visão técnica e com o Founding Operator na priorização de produto


STACK


Code-first, AI-native, enxuto. Stack atual (e onde queremos chegar):

TypeScript (Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, React) · Python (FastAPI, NLP, agentes) · PostgreSQL · vector DBs (Weaviate, ChromaDB) · OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain · AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker · GitHub Actions · Cursor, Claude e MCP pra programar todo dia · Stripe pra billing · Bubble (legacy, vamos migrar/desmontar conforme fizer sentido).


Você não precisa ter usado tudo. Precisa ser muito confortável aprendendo rápido e operando full-stack de verdade.


QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS


• 5+ anos construindo software em produção, com pelo menos 1 produto B2B sério no histórico

• Domínio de TypeScript + Python (ou conforto absoluto pra ir e vir entre os dois)

• Experiência com banco relacional, APIs, auth, deploy, logs e debugging em produção

• Capacidade de ir do problema de negócio ao código sem travar

• Uso intenso de IA pra programar, pesquisar, documentar, testar, prototipar e automatizar

• Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e cargo de CTO

• Capacidade de fazer deep work técnico E pensamento de arquitetura no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois


DIFERENCIAIS


• Já ter sido founding engineer ou CTO #1 de startup que atingiu PMF

• Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-stack) em estúdio, agência ou holding

• Experiência com IA em produção: prompts, evals, guardrails, latência, custo, RAG, multi-agent

• Experiência com migração/sunset de plataforma low-code (Bubble, Webflow) pra stack code-first

• Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 3 a 10 engenheiros

• Vontade real de virar CTO de verdade: visão, hiring, board, captação, demissão


COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO


Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. Ship, depois uptime, depois escala.


• Ship (semanas 1-12): 5 produtos lançáveis, com infra compartilhada de billing/auth/observability operando

• Uptime (mês 4+): SLA em produção, MTTR baixo, incidentes resolvidos com postmortem

• Escala (mês 6+): infra suportando 10x usuários sem refatoração; novo micro-app entra com setup de poucos dias

• Time: cadência de contratação alinhada com receita; mentoria efetiva do dev pleno e juniors

• Ownership: você define meta técnica, executa, comunica risco cedo, entrega sem precisar ser microgerenciado


CULTURA HAMURABI


Não confundimos flexibilidade com baixa intensidade. Não confundimos remoto com folga. Usamos muito IA, mas também esperamos que você saiba o que está acontecendo por baixo: cliente, dor real, produto, número, contrato, relacionamento. A gente não tem fôlego pra carregar quem não está produzindo. Quem performa tem autonomia total, equity founding-level e cargo de CTO crescendo com o estúdio.


• Ownership extremo • Honestidade radical • Entrega acima de discurso • Velocidade com qualidade • Customer love acima de tudo • Multi-produto, multi-stack, multi-chapéu • IA como alavanca diária

• TODO MUNDO DONO (sim, aqui todos os founding members tem equity).


POTENCIAL DE GANHO


Compensação inicial é equity-only de propósito. O upside é o ponto inteiro dessa vaga.


Equity: 15% founding-level, vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano. Em tese realizada (R$ 5M+ de ARR, múltiplos SaaS B2B 5-10x), pode atingir R$ 3,75M-7,5M. Em tese acelerada (R$ 15M+ de ARR), R$ 11M-22M.


Comp. destravada por receita:

• MRR R$ 30k/mês: base R$ 8k/mês PJ (~R$ 96k/ano)

• MRR R$ 80k/mês: base R$ 15k/mês (R$ 180k/ano)

• MRR R$ 200k/mês: base R$ 25k/mês + bônus por milestone


Bônus por milestone: definido caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários).


COMO APLICAR


Lemos toda aplicação séria e damos retorno.


E-mail:

• Para:

• Assunto: Founding CTO - Hamurabi - Aplicacao

• LinkedIn ou GitHub + texto curto se apresentando


Responda também:

• Por que você quer ser CTO da Hamurabi no modelo micro-apps studio?

• Qual o sistema mais difícil que você já colocou em produção? Stack, escala, decisões

• Como você usa IA hoje no seu trabalho de engenharia?

• Olhando os 5 produtos acima, qual você abordaria primeiro tecnicamente, e por quê?

• Você topa equity-only no início, com gatilhos de receita destravando comp?

title: Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Analyst/ Data Scientist

Experience

Minimum 5 years


Engagement Type

Short Term Contract ( 3 months)


Skill

  • 3+ years data analytics or data science
  • Strong SQL (complex queries, CTEs, window functions) and understanding of dimensional modeling (fact/dim tables)
  • Experience with product event data (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel patterns)
  • BigQuery experience and Familiar with data quality challenges and how to handle them

Availability

8 hours per day with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.



Role Overview

We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst/ Data Scientist who is strong in SQL and understands how product data works, who has built schemas, debugged data quality issues, and explained to someone why two dashboards show different numbers for the same metric.

What does day-to-day life look like?

You will define the data infrastructure behind these product teams - what tables exist, what events fire, what breaks. Think of it as designing the realistic data environment an analyst would actually query. We are building an AI benchmark and need realistic data artifacts - BigQuery schemas, SQL queries, event taxonomies, metric definitions. You will write and review these, making sure they are technically accurate and include the kind of data quality issues you would see in real systems.


Requirements


  • 5+ years data analytics or data science
  • Strong SQL (complex queries, CTEs, window functions) and understanding of dimensional modeling (fact/dim tables)
  • Experience with product event data (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel patterns)
  • BigQuery experience and Familiar with data quality challenges and how to handle them


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 6 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India/ LATAM

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Associate Account Executive - Biopharma em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America.   • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.

Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.

  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)-  Banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco de talentos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. A atividade diária principal será receber artes prontas das agências dos EUA para executar ajustes (no InDesign) conforme comentários (em inglês) feitos no PDF. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica.

Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
  • Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso.
  • Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator;
  • Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h.

title: BI Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para BI Operations Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Founding Engineer (Path to CTO)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Founding Engineer (Path to CTO) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A VAGA


A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa engenheira, builder, intensa e extremamente dona pra ser nossa CTO fundadora.


A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Founding Engineer: codando todos os dias, polindo os 5 produtos até estado lançável, construindo infra compartilhada e operando produto em produção. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, você assume o papel pleno de CTO: contratação, arquitetura, mentoria, direção técnica, e cada vez menos código diário.


Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding Operator, que vamos trazer em paralelo.


SNAPSHOT


• Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges)

• Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO)

• Equity: 15% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão)

• Bônus por milestone de produto: definidos caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários)

• Path to CTO consolidado: Cargo se consolida com 3+ engenheiros sob você e infra em produção com SLA

• Perfil: full-stack sênior ou staff, AI-native, customer-obsessed, confortável codando legal-tech, dev-tools, cloud, ERP e agentes no mesmo mês


O QUE FAZEMOS


A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF.


Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente):

• Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house

• Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs

• Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows

• ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional)

• Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt


NOSSA MISSÃO


Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois.


COMO É O DIA A DIA


Você não vai herdar uma engenharia rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem head of eng, QA dedicado, DevOps. Tem o Pablo (founder, também codador), o Founding Operator (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos com graus diferentes de maturidade.


A pessoa certa abre issue do produto jurídico às 9h, faz code review do dev pleno às 11h, refatora o RAG do produto de analytics à tarde, sobe deploy do produto de cloud à noite, e no dia seguinte abre PR de uma abstração compartilhada que vai servir o próximo micro-app.


NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ:


• Espera receber arquitetura desenhada e sprint planejado. Aqui você É o arquiteto e o planner

• Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, gatilhos e milestones

• Não codifica em produção há mais de 6 meses. A vaga é hands-on do dia 1

• Tem ego de cargo. Você vai escrever código, fazer deploy, debugar produção, code review, JD, tudo, sozinho, no começo

• Não usa IA pra programar (Cursor, Claude, MCP). Aqui IA escreve a maior parte do boilerplate

• Tem medo de mexer em múltiplas linguagens/stacks ao mesmo tempo (TS, Python, infra, AI, frontend)

• Precisa de processo todo desenhado e backlog todo grooming antes de começar

• Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos ship rate, uptime e qualidade semanalmente desde o dia 1


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Construir e shippar (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses):

• Polir os 5 produtos do portfólio até estado lançável (UX, performance, billing, onboarding, observabilidade)

• Codar diariamente em produção. Backend, frontend, infra, AI, integrações: você cobre tudo

• Estabelecer infra compartilhada (billing, auth, observability, analytics) entre os 5 produtos

• Subir o que quebrar, otimizar o que estiver lento, refatorar o que estiver podre


Operar e escalar (escopo cresce a partir do mês 3):

• Uptime, SLAs, segurança, custo de infra, CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call

• Migrar/desmontar o que sobrou de Bubble pra stack code-first quando fizer sentido

• Construir abstrações reutilizáveis pro próximo micro-app entrar com fricção mínima


Construir time e arquitetura (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6):

• Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava

• Formar e mentorar o dev pleno e os juniors que já estão no radar

• Definir padrões de código, arquitetura, testing, code review, documentação

• Trabalhar com o Pablo na visão técnica e com o Founding Operator na priorização de produto


STACK


Code-first, AI-native, enxuto. Stack atual (e onde queremos chegar):

TypeScript (Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, React) · Python (FastAPI, NLP, agentes) · PostgreSQL · vector DBs (Weaviate, ChromaDB) · OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain · AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker · GitHub Actions · Cursor, Claude e MCP pra programar todo dia · Stripe pra billing · Bubble (legacy, vamos migrar/desmontar conforme fizer sentido).


Você não precisa ter usado tudo. Precisa ser muito confortável aprendendo rápido e operando full-stack de verdade.


QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS


• 5+ anos construindo software em produção, com pelo menos 1 produto B2B sério no histórico

• Domínio de TypeScript + Python (ou conforto absoluto pra ir e vir entre os dois)

• Experiência com banco relacional, APIs, auth, deploy, logs e debugging em produção

• Capacidade de ir do problema de negócio ao código sem travar

• Uso intenso de IA pra programar, pesquisar, documentar, testar, prototipar e automatizar

• Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e cargo de CTO

• Capacidade de fazer deep work técnico E pensamento de arquitetura no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois


DIFERENCIAIS


• Já ter sido founding engineer ou CTO #1 de startup que atingiu PMF

• Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-stack) em estúdio, agência ou holding

• Experiência com IA em produção: prompts, evals, guardrails, latência, custo, RAG, multi-agent

• Experiência com migração/sunset de plataforma low-code (Bubble, Webflow) pra stack code-first

• Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 3 a 10 engenheiros

• Vontade real de virar CTO de verdade: visão, hiring, board, captação, demissão


COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO


Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. Ship, depois uptime, depois escala.


• Ship (semanas 1-12): 5 produtos lançáveis, com infra compartilhada de billing/auth/observability operando

• Uptime (mês 4+): SLA em produção, MTTR baixo, incidentes resolvidos com postmortem

• Escala (mês 6+): infra suportando 10x usuários sem refatoração; novo micro-app entra com setup de poucos dias

• Time: cadência de contratação alinhada com receita; mentoria efetiva do dev pleno e juniors

• Ownership: você define meta técnica, executa, comunica risco cedo, entrega sem precisar ser microgerenciado


CULTURA HAMURABI


Não confundimos flexibilidade com baixa intensidade. Não confundimos remoto com folga. Usamos muito IA, mas também esperamos que você saiba o que está acontecendo por baixo: cliente, dor real, produto, número, contrato, relacionamento. A gente não tem fôlego pra carregar quem não está produzindo. Quem performa tem autonomia total, equity founding-level e cargo de CTO crescendo com o estúdio.


• Ownership extremo • Honestidade radical • Entrega acima de discurso • Velocidade com qualidade • Customer love acima de tudo • Multi-produto, multi-stack, multi-chapéu • IA como alavanca diária

• TODO MUNDO DONO (sim, aqui todos os founding members tem equity).


POTENCIAL DE GANHO


Compensação inicial é equity-only de propósito. O upside é o ponto inteiro dessa vaga.


Equity: 15% founding-level, vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano. Em tese realizada (R$ 5M+ de ARR, múltiplos SaaS B2B 5-10x), pode atingir R$ 3,75M-7,5M. Em tese acelerada (R$ 15M+ de ARR), R$ 11M-22M.


Comp. destravada por receita:

• MRR R$ 30k/mês: base R$ 8k/mês PJ (~R$ 96k/ano)

• MRR R$ 80k/mês: base R$ 15k/mês (R$ 180k/ano)

• MRR R$ 200k/mês: base R$ 25k/mês + bônus por milestone


Bônus por milestone: definido caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários).


COMO APLICAR


Lemos toda aplicação séria e damos retorno.


E-mail:

• Para:

• Assunto: Founding CTO - Hamurabi - Aplicacao

• LinkedIn ou GitHub + texto curto se apresentando


Responda também:

• Por que você quer ser CTO da Hamurabi no modelo micro-apps studio?

• Qual o sistema mais difícil que você já colocou em produção? Stack, escala, decisões

• Como você usa IA hoje no seu trabalho de engenharia?

• Olhando os 5 produtos acima, qual você abordaria primeiro tecnicamente, e por quê?

• Você topa equity-only no início, com gatilhos de receita destravando comp?

title: Data Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Growth Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Growth Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Localização

Remoto


Tipo de Contrato

Prestação de Serviços (PJ)


Sobre a vaga

Procuramos Project Manager pra coordenar a execução das contas de growth da agência. A pessoa é o motor que transforma estratégia em entrega: traduz decisão em brief, distribui pra especialistas (conteúdo, criação, dev, mídia paga, etc), garante prazo, antecipa bloqueio e mantém o cliente com a sensação de que tudo está rodando.

Não é função de atendimento estratégico. Estratégia é definida pelo especialista em growth. Você é quem garante que ela vira realidade no prazo certo, com qualidade.

Atendemos clientes B2B no Brasil e nos Estados Unidos, então parte da operação acontece em inglês. 

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Traduzir decisões estratégicas (vindas de call ou clip gravado no ClickUp) em briefs claros pros especialistas
  • Coordenar sprints quinzenais de cada cliente, do planning à entrega
  • Cobrar prazo e qualidade dos especialistas internos sem virar atrito
  • Manter o ClickUp como fonte única de verdade: tasks atualizadas, status correto, prazos visíveis
  • Antecipar bloqueios e escalar pro Growth Lead antes de virar problema com cliente
  • Participar de reuniões internas e produzir artefatos (atas com decisões e planos de ação)
  • Cuidar de comunicação operacional com cliente (status report, follow-up de aprovação, agendamento) em português e inglês
  • Identificar pontos de fricção no processo da agência e propor melhoria


O que você precisa ter vivido

  • +2 anos coordenando projetos, idealmente em agência, consultoria ou ops de startup
  • Inglês fluente, escrito e falado. Você vai conduzir reuniões, escrever status reports e trocar mensagens com clientes nos EUA
  • Comunicação escrita clara e objetiva em português e inglês (vamos pedir exemplo nos dois idiomas no processo seletivo)
  • Domínio de ClickUp. Operamos 100% no ClickUp, então fluência aqui acelera muito a entrada
  • Capacidade de cobrar prazo de pessoa mais sênior tecnicamente sem perder a mão
  • Organização obsessiva: você é a pessoa que nunca esquece follow-up


Diferencial, mas não obrigatório

  • Experiência prévia em agência de marketing ou growth
  • Vivência atendendo cliente internacional, especialmente nos EUA
  • Familiaridade com vocabulário de growth B2B (funil, ABM, mídia paga, lifecycle)
  • Vivência em automatização de processo (Zapier e agentes do ClickUp)


O que não esperamos

Não precisa ter experiência executando campanha, escrevendo copy ou desenhando estratégia. Esse não é o papel. Se você gosta mais de operar do que criar conteúdo de growth, é pra você.


Como vamos medir seu trabalho

  • Entregas saindo no prazo combinado em cada sprint
  • Tempo do Growth Lead liberado pra estratégia (você cuida da execução)
  • Adoção e consistência dos processos da agência no ClickUp
  • Saúde das contas que você coordena (sem cliente surpreso com atraso)


Contexto importante

Estamos em transição para um novo modelo de agência. Boa parte do processo de operação está sendo desenhada agora, e quem entrar nesse momento influencia como a agência vai funcionar daqui pra frente. Se você curte ambiente em construção e quer deixar marca no processo, vai gostar. Se prefere chegar em estrutura totalmente pronta, esse provavelmente não é o melhor momento.

Se você se reconheceu na descrição e quer construir esse processo junto, candidate-se aqui:
